verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents service accounts built for programmatic API access from CI/CD pipelines, automation scripts and other non-human systems, without tying credentials to individual users. Dashboards can be managed as code, an official MCP server and Agent Skills let AI agents query data and manage dashboards and alerts, and the product can be self-hosted via Docker or Kubernetes. missing for 10: a dedicated CLI or documented CI integration examples (e.g., pipeline recipes), a discoverable published OpenAPI spec (probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
